nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner, set in the Owned constructor from msg.sender and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
ERC20 token symbol string, set to "BETA" in the BETA constructor.
ERC20 token name string, set to "Crypto Smart Beta" in the BETA constructor.
Token decimals, set to 18 in the BETA constructor.
Total token supply variable, assigned in the BETA constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping of holder address to token balance; read and written by transfer, transferFrom, balanceOf and totalSupply.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance; read and written by approve, transferFrom, allowance and approveAndCall.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance debits, allowances and as argument to external calls.
SafeMath addition helper returning c = a + b with a require overflow guard.
SafeMath subtraction helper returning c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a).
SafeMath multiplication helper returning c = a * b with an overflow require.
SafeMath division helper returning c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0).
Constructor of Owned that assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing initial privileged control.
Owner-only function storing _newOwner into the newOwner state variable (two-step ownership transfer step 1).
Function that requires msg.sender == newOwner and then completes ownership transfer, resetting newOwner to address(0).
Constructor of BETA that sets symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and pre-mints the whole supply to a fixed address.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] as the effective circulating supply.
Constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 transfer that debits balances[msg.sender] via safeSub and credits balances[to] via safeAdd.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits the Approval event.
Spends an allowance: debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] via safeSub and credits balances[to] via safeAdd.
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Approves spender and then calls the untrusted spender contract's receiveApproval(...) callback with msg.sender, tokens and data.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner function performing an external ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) call to rescue accidentally sent tokens.
Untrusted external call to ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed before state finalization, enabling reentrancy into BETA.
Arbitrary external call to an attacker-supplied token contract address in transferAnyERC20Token, returning its boolean result.
Raw arithmetic expressions (a+b, a-b, a*b, a/b) inside SafeMath helpers whose correctness depends solely on require guards.
Input address parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership.
Input address parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf.
Recipient address parameter to of transfer.
Amount parameter tokens of transfer.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Allowance amount parameter tokens of approve.

Recipient address parameter to of transferFrom.
Amount parameter tokens of transferFrom.
Address parameter tokenOwner of allowance.
Address parameter spender of allowance.
Spender contract address parameter of approveAndCall.
Allowance amount parameter tokens of approveAndCall.
Arbitrary calldata bytes parameter data forwarded to receiveApproval in approveAndCall.
Caller-supplied external token contract address parameter of transferAnyERC20Token.
Amount parameter tokens of transferAnyERC20Token.
First operand a of safeAdd.
Second operand b of safeAdd.
First operand a of safeSub.
Second operand b of safeSub.
First operand a of safeMul.
Second operand b of safeMul.
First operand a of safeDiv.
Second operand b (denominator) of safeDiv.
Return variable c holding the addition result inside safeAdd.
Return variable c holding the subtraction result inside safeSub.
Return variable c holding the multiplication result inside safeMul.
Return variable c holding the division result inside safeDiv.

edges.reason: The onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner before transferOwnership body executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to authorize the ownership handover.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by onlyOwner which checks msg.sender against owner.
transfer indexes balances with msg.sender as the debited account.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller address.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender], coupling caller identity to allowance spending.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender into the external callback.
The Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, granting initial privileges to the deployer.
transferOwnership reads the owner state variable inside the onlyOwner require.
transferAnyERC20Token reads owner through the onlyOwner modifier check.
acceptOwnership reads the newOwner state variable in its require statement.
acceptOwnership assigns owner = newOwner, completing the two-step transfer.
totalSupply computes _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
totalSupply subtracts the burned balance read from balances[address(0)].
The BETA constructor assigns the whole supply into _totalSupply and mints it to a fixed holder.
transfer reads balances[msg.sender] and balances[to] before writing updated values.
transfer writes the updated sender and recipient balances back into the balances mapping.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
approve writes the granted amount into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom reads allowed[from][msg.sender] to validate the spend.
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance through safeSub.
transferFrom reads balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom writes adjusted balances for both from and to addresses.
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall reads the allowed mapping structure when setting the new allowance.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens.
approveAndCall transfers control to the caller-supplied spender contract through receiveApproval.
The untrusted spender contract can re-enter BETA functions from within the receiveApproval callback.
transferAnyERC20Token invokes an external ERC20 transfer on a caller-provided contract address.
transferAnyERC20Token directs the rescued tokens to the owner address.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance with an underflow guard.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance with an overflow guard.
transferFrom calls safeSub for both the balance and the allowance debit.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
safeSub executes the raw subtraction a - b that the unsafe arithmetic operation represents.
safeAdd executes the raw addition a + b guarded only by require(c >= a).
safeMul executes the raw multiplication a * b guarded only by an equality require.
The _newOwner parameter flows into the transferOwnership body.
The _newOwner parameter is stored into the newOwner state variable.
tokenOwner parameter is used as the lookup key in balanceOf.
The to parameter is the credited account in transfer.
The tokens parameter is the transferred amount in transfer.
The spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
The tokens parameter is the granted allowance amount in approve.
The from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
The to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is the transferred amount in transferFrom.
The tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
The spender parameter indexes the inner allowed mapping in allowance.
The spender parameter is both the allowance key and the external callee in approveAndCall.
The tokens parameter is the granted allowance amount in approveAndCall.
The data bytes parameter is forwarded verbatim into the receiveApproval external call.
The tokenAddress parameter is cast to ERC20Interface and called externally.
The tokens parameter is the amount passed to the external ERC20 transfer.
Operand a flows into the safeAdd addition.
Operand b flows into the safeAdd addition.
Operand a flows into the safeSub subtraction.
Operand b flows into the safeSub subtraction and its require check.
Operand a flows into the safeMul multiplication.
Operand b flows into the safeMul multiplication and overflow check.
Operand a flows into the safeDiv division numerator.
Operand b flows into the safeDiv denominator and require(b > 0) check.
Local return variable c carries the result out of safeAdd.
Local return variable c carries the result out of safeSub.
Local return variable c carries the result out of safeMul.
Local return variable c carries the result out of safeDiv.

normalization_plan.reason: The _newOwner parameter has no independent security semantics and is only meaningful as the input of the transferOwnership state update.
The tokenOwner parameter is a pure read key for the balanceOf view function and can be folded into it.
The to parameter only exists to select the credited balances slot inside transfer.
The tokens parameter only exists as the credited/debited amount inside transfer.
The spender parameter is only used as the allowance key written by approve.
The tokens parameter is only the literal allowance value written by approve.
The from parameter has no standalone behaviour and is only the debited account of transferFrom.
The to parameter only selects the credited account inside transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is only the moved amount inside transferFrom.
The tokenOwner parameter is a pure lookup key for the allowance view function.
The spender parameter is a pure inner lookup key for the allowance view function.
The spender parameter is both the allowance key and the external callee address, so it collapses into approveAndCall.
The tokens parameter is only the allowance value written by approveAndCall.
The data bytes travel straight into the untrusted receiveApproval call and belong to that unsafe operation.
The tokenAddress parameter is only relevant because it becomes the target contract of the unsafe external call.
The tokens parameter is only the amount forwarded by transferAnyERC20Token.
Operand a of safeAdd is a pure numeric input consumed by the addition helper.
Operand b of safeAdd is a pure numeric input consumed by the addition helper.
Operand a of safeSub is a pure numeric input consumed by the subtraction helper.
Operand b of safeSub is a pure numeric input consumed by the subtraction helper and its require guard.
Operand a of safeMul is a pure numeric input consumed by the multiplication helper.
Operand b of safeMul is a pure numeric input consumed by the multiplication helper.
Operand a of safeDiv is a pure numeric numerator input with no independent semantics.
Operand b of safeDiv is the denominator consumed by the division helper and its require check.
Return variable c of safeAdd is a transient holder of the arithmetic result and can be merged into safeAdd.
Return variable c of safeSub is a transient holder of the arithmetic result and can be merged into safeSub.
Return variable c of safeMul is a transient holder of the arithmetic result and can be merged into safeMul.
Return variable c of safeDiv is a transient holder of the arithmetic result and can be merged into safeDiv.
